Count fragments over gene body plus promoter into a gene activity store

gene_activity_sc.Rd

Signac's GeneActivity(): per gene, the longest span of its biotype, under max_width, extended upstream of the TSS; each overlapping fragment counts once. The result is a SingleCells() over every cell of object, in its order and with its obs and cell filter, so it serves as the query of transfer_labels_seurat_sc() and of the RNA tools. Methods that assume RNA counts refuse it or warn. Written to the default directory, later cell filters on object reach it; reopen it with get_gene_activity().

Usage

gene_activity_sc(
  object,
  fragments,
  gtf,
  dir_out = NULL,
  ga_params = params_atac_gene_activity(),
  target_size = NULL,
  barcode_map = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  max_mem_gb = NULL,
  .verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

object

SingleCells class whose cell ids are the fragment barcodes (a SingleCellsMultiModal or a SingleCellsAtac).

fragments

String. The fragment file (BGZF, gzip or plain).

gtf

String. Gene annotation (GENCODE, Ensembl, or a transcript-only GTF).

dir_out

Optional string. Output directory. NULL uses gene_activity inside the experiment directory.

ga_params

List. Output of params_atac_gene_activity().

target_size

Optional numeric. Target of the log-CPM norm. NULL uses the median RNA lib_size of the kept cells, as the Signac vignettes do, or 1e4 on an ATAC-only experiment, whose lib_size counts peaks.

barcode_map

Optional. Cell id to fragment barcode, where they differ: a named character vector or a function.

overwrite

Boolean. Replace an existing store at dir_out.

max_mem_gb

Optional numeric. Memory budget of the gene-major conversion.

.verbose

Boolean. Controls verbosity.

Value

The gene activity experiment as a loaded SingleCells. var holds gene_id (the GTF gene ID without its version, as Cell Ranger keys the RNA), gene_name (made unique), chrom, start and end; obs's lib_size and nnz are the gene activity's.

References

Stuart, et al., Nat Methods, 2021
